title: Partly Parted Party
overview: It’s been four weeks since Jake and his ex broke up when Jake’s best friend, Roddy, invites him to attend a party. However, upon realizing that his ex is in attendance at the party, Jake refuses to enter, settling for spending the night on the porch. In an effort to salvage the night and fulfill his promises, Jake sparks many interactions with party goers either looking for a smoke break, some fresh air, or even some private time.
